plan.order.drag: Drag to reorder · on mobile, long-press and drag
plan.pv.empty: Add companions to the team to see the preview.
plan.sum.order.manual: All turns locked · {n} turns · edit in Advanced settings

sync.presetFull: Up to 3 EX links · delete one and try again
plan.adv.title: Advanced settings
plan.adv.start.import.desc: Keep the main order, per-turn plans and exception turns as they are.
plan.adv.start.basic.desc: Reset the action plan to each role's default rhythm and start (undoable).
plan.adv.resume.done: Advanced settings on · previous settings restored
plan.adv.off.done: Advanced settings off · turn on again to restore
plan.adv.proc.note: A chance-based cooldown altar is on. To plan EX Skills on the earlier turns, turn on each companion's 'Assumed success'.
plan.adv.grid.clear.done: Pinned cells and locked turns cleared
plan.step1.title: Order and EX Skill
plan.mode.clear.done: {name} per-turn plan cleared · back to auto
plan.ult.mode.hint.light: EX Skill mode: Auto follows the role's default rhythm; Per turn lets you set each turn.
plan.turn.label: Actions by turn
plan.turn.hint: Tap a cell to pick that turn's action
plan.turn.cdHint: Turns where the cooldown hasn't come back can't be set to EX Skill. Unset turns follow the role's default rhythm.
plan.turn.cell.nocd: Cooldown not back · can't set EX Skill
plan.fed.manualHint: Set the mode to Per turn to choose the extra action granted by {name} each turn.
plan.step2.title: Exception Turns
plan.step2.hint: Use a different action order on specific turns only.
plan.exc.sheet.turnsHint: Pick several turns to apply the same order at once. Turns with a dot already have an exception.
plan.preview.title: Run preview
plan.preview.hint: Actions from one run of the current settings with all chances at 100%. Hover a cell to see that turn's actions.
plan.adv.sync.ukPreset.desc: On turns {anchor} uses an EX Skill, {names} use a Normal Attack and then the EX Skill with the extra action. Delete it here or toggle it with the checkbox on {anchor}'s row in the main action plan.
plan.adv.forced: The altar is on, so edit in Advanced settings only
plan.adv.forced.cond: With the altar on, the action plan is edited in Advanced settings only.
plan.mode.direct.tip: Set the action for each turn yourself (shows turn cells below).
plan.adv.grid.hint: Tap a cell to pick its action; tap a turn number to edit that turn.
plan.cellSheet.lock: Lock this turn (as it runs now)
plan.adv.use.label: Use advanced settings
plan.adv.use.desc: When on, ①–④ below are used for runs and the main action plan is locked. When off, the modes, success assumptions, EX links and locked turns set here are kept aside and only the main settings are used (restored when turned back on).
plan.adv.banner: Advanced settings on — edit actions in Advanced settings
plan.adv.enter.main: Edit detailed actions in Advanced settings
plan.adv.enter.sub: EX Skill mode · EX links · Turn-by-turn plan
plan.adv.prio: When settings overlap on a cell, the earlier one wins: locked turns > EX link > EX Skill mode > pinned cells > exception turns (order only).
plan.ult.mode.hint: Ultimate mode: Auto follows the role's default rhythm (a missed ultimate fires as soon as it is ready), Set turns only uses default turns and pinned cells (skipped if not ready that turn), As soon as ready fires whenever the cooldown is up. Unpinned cells follow this mode.
plan.turn.cdHint.adv: Cell color = what actually runs (same as ④), outline and dot = pinned, orange dot = the run differs from the pin. Unpinned cells follow the ultimate mode above; turns whose cooldown is not back cannot be pinned to an ultimate.
plan.row.assist.noAltar: No effect: the chance-based cooldown altars (1012, 1013) are off
plan.row.keepDef.tip: As soon as ready / following companions: a pinned Defend cell defends even when the EX Skill is ready. Turn off to use the EX Skill on ready Defend cells.
plan.row.keepDef.dead: Auto and Set turns only always keep pinned Defend cells · this option only applies to As soon as ready and following companions
plan.grid.masked: Pinned cell ({act}) is hidden by a locked turn · this turn runs the locked order and actions
plan.exc.masked: Turn {turns} hidden by a locked turn
plan.sync.preset.confirm: Your current EX links will be replaced by the {name} preset (overwrites the existing {name} group and neighbor settings)
plan.adv.forceOff: Escape Room Altars on · Always proc was turned off (they can't be combined)
plan.row.assist.single: Once-per-battle EX Skill · not affected by chance cooldown cuts
plan.ult.assist.tip: Instead of rolling chance-based cooldown cuts, counts just enough of them as successful on EX Skill turns. With Auto or Planned turns only, the first EX Skill moves earlier (3-turn cooldown → turns 3, 6, 9; 2-turn cooldown → from turn 2), and you can pin EX Skills on turns the base cooldown cannot reach. The result header shows how likely that exact flow is.
plan.te.lockAll.tip: Locks every turn exactly as the current result
plan.step2.hint.adv: Use a different action order on specific turns only. Changing only the order after tapping a turn number in ④ does the same.
plan.fed.manualHint.adv: Pin at least one cell in this companion's row in ④ to choose the extra action granted by {name} each turn.
plan.step3.title: EX Skill link
plan.sync.hint: Align following companions to the turns the lead uses its EX Skill. Up to 3 groups; a companion can be in only one group.
plan.sync.sub: Followers use their EX Skill on the lead's EX Skill turns · up to 3 groups, one group per companion · priority 2 (priority 1 = locked turns; EX links are skipped there)
plan.row.assist.asap: As soon as ready only uses the EX Skill once the cooldown is really back, so success is never assumed. Switch to Auto or Set turns only to plan earlier EX Skills.
plan.row.assist.fedCarry: Slot 1 receives {name}'s extra action, so without pinned cells the first EX Skill is not moved earlier (the engine would keep the line's Normal Attacks and change the EX order). Pin the EX cells in ④ to move it.
plan.grid.row.clear: Clear all pins in this row
plan.grid.fed.title: Extra actions granted by {name}
plan.grid.fed.hint: Applied when {taeho}'s row has pinned cells.
plan.turn.preset.defRush: Pull EX Skill forward with Def
plan.turn.preset.tip.allUlt: EX Skill on every turn it comes off cooldown
plan.turn.preset.tip.ult3: EX Skill on turns 4·7·10… (every 3 turns), Normal Attack otherwise
plan.turn.preset.tip.ult3.10437: EX Skill on turns 4·7·10… · 3 Normal Attacks build 5 Neon Marks to trigger the seal effect (extra damage to all enemies)
plan.turn.preset.tip.ult3.10442: EX Skill on turns 4·7·10… · Normal Attacks stack Kuzushi (+20.25% EX Skill effect per stack) first
plan.turn.preset.tip.pdef: Def on the turn right before each EX Skill (carry the Def effect into the next EX Skill)
plan.turn.preset.tip.pdef.10421: Def right before each EX Skill · Long Pass Prep: Def raises own base ATK by 30% (2 turns), applied to the next EX Skill
plan.turn.preset.tip.pdef.10426: On the base rhythm (CD 2 turns), Def before each EX Skill · Molting Cicada: spending Ran's Aura (gained by EX Skill) on Def makes the position-4 ally's attack give Ran +108% triggered skill effect (2 turns) and 5 Tidefang stacks, so the next EX Skill hits harder. No Def before the first EX Skill (no Aura yet). The position-4 ally must act after Ran
plan.turn.preset.tip.ult3def: EX Skill every 3 turns from the first one, Def on the turn right before
plan.turn.preset.tip.ult3def.10426: EX Skill on turns 3·6·9…, Def on 5·8·11… (Normal Attack → Def → EX Skill) · Molting Cicada: spending Ran's Aura on Def makes the position-4 ally's attack give Ran +108% triggered skill effect (2 turns) and 5 Tidefang stacks. The position-4 ally must act after Ran
plan.turn.preset.tip.defRush: Use Def to cut EX Skill CD and cast it as early as possible (the needed Def turns are placed automatically)
plan.turn.preset.tip.defRush.10436: Pursuit Ambush: allies' Normal Attacks stack Pursuit, Def cuts CD by the stack count · with 3 attacking allies ahead: Def → Def → EX Skill, then Normal Attack → Def → EX Skill with the leftover Pursuit (every 3 turns). Moiru must act after the allies
plan.turn.preset.tip.defRush.10433: Reel In: with Bite on the target (from Normal Attack), Def cuts EX Skill CD by 1 and raises EX Skill effect by 30% (2 turns) · Normal Attack → Def → EX Skill (every 3 turns)
plan.turn.preset.tip.reflow: Keep the first EX Skill and re-place the rest on every turn it comes off cooldown
plan.pin.defHint: Def cuts this ally's CD · earlier turns are set to Def automatically when needed
plan.pin.defended: {name} · turns {turns} set to Def so the EX Skill is ready on turn {turn}
plan.pin.impossible.stack: {name} · no EX Skill on turn {turn} · not enough ally Normal Attacks to cut the CD with Def
plan.pin.impossible.cd: {name} · no EX Skill on turn {turn} · even with Def the CD is not back by then
plan.pin.impossible.overlap: {name} · an EX Skill on turn {turn} needs an earlier pinned EX Skill turn changed to Def · clear that pin first
plan.pin.single: {name} · one EX Skill per battle · pinned EX Skills on other turns were cleared
plan.turn.cell.immune: CD not back · immune to EX Skill CD changes from {name} (chance/Def CD cuts do nothing) · EX Skill not allowed
plan.grid.immune: CD not back · immune to EX Skill CD changes from {name} (chance/Def CD cuts do nothing)
plan.exc.warn.stack: {name} · acts before the other allies on turn {turns}, so their Normal Attacks that turn add no Pursuit to the Def CD cut · pinned EX Skills may slip
plan.row.preset.asap: With 'As soon as ready', EX Skill beats pinned Normal Attacks, so this preset has no effect · switch to Auto or Planned turns only
altar.proc.help2: The action plan doesn't factor in this chance effect by default. To see the flow of using EX Skills on set turns, turn on per-companion ‘Assume success’ in Action plan › Advanced settings › EX Skill mode.
altar.proc.note: An altar that cuts EX Skill cooldown by chance (chance CD cut) is on. To see EX Skills used on set turns (e.g. turns 3·6·9·12), use per-companion ‘Assume success’ in Action plan › Advanced settings › EX Skill mode; to use them whenever they're ready at the actual chance, use ‘As soon as ready’.
cmp.order.lockedAll: All turns are locked, so action order is set in Turn editing in Advanced settings
cmp.pinsCleared: The companion in that slot changed, so that slot's pinned cells and locked turn entries were cleared

plan.grid.th.locked: Turn {turn} · locked turn · tap to edit
plan.sync.afterNote: With ‘EX Skill after’, {name} acts after {anchor}'s EX Skill, so there's no granted extra action. To also get the extra action, use ‘EX Skill before’.
plan.te.save.hint.asIs: No changes · locking keeps the current result as is
plan.te.save.hint.clearExc: Same as the default order · saving clears the exception turn
plan.te.save.hint.exc: Actions unchanged · order applies to this turn only (exception turn)
plan.te.save.hint.lock: Actions changed · saving locks this turn
plan.te.status.exc: This turn only has a different order (exception turn). Actions follow the rules.
plan.te.status.locked: This is a locked turn. It runs the order and actions below as is, instead of the rules and pinned cells.
plan.te.status.rule: This turn follows the rules. Changing only the order makes it an exception turn; changing actions locks this turn.
plan.te.title: Edit turn {turn}
